rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Chained-prompt isolation — don't leak downstream pipeline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: extract-the-task-shaping-rule-1 (propose/reject rules) makes no mention of file location or automation. extract-the-task-shaping-rule-2 (pick location, write file) makes no mention of the automation-shapes ask that follows in Phase 3. Each prompt produces its output as if downstream didn't exist.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-vs-STOP tail ordering — last imperative wins.
rules_evaluated.evidence: extract-the-task-shaping-rule-2.md reads, in order: '...write the rules in the wording I sharpened. After saving, show me the first three rules from the file so I can confirm the wording stuck. If a file already exists at the path we pick, ask before overwriting.' The overwrite-check is a precondition that logically belongs BEFORE the write, but is textually the last sentence, after both 'write the rules' and 'show me the first three rules' (which presumes the write already happened). Low-severity in practice — a competent agent infers the sensible check-then-write order regardless of sentence position, and the trace shows no persona confusion here — but the fence's own sentence order doesn't match the sequence it describes.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Move the overwrite-check clause immediately after the location is picked and before 'write the rules', so the fence's sentence order matches execution order.

teaching_moment_lands.note: The named teaching moment — 'the rule sits in MY file at MY location; I see how this could automate; I'm not building it today' — fires reliably across the trace with zero confusion_flags at any of the three phases and an is_me_rating of 8 at close. The rewrite-or-reject forcing function (Phase 1), the location choice with loading-model tradeoffs (Phase 2), and the no-code automation-shapes ask (Phase 3) are each enacted inside their fenced prompts (see check_pedagogy.md #16), not narrated in body prose, so the moment doesn't depend on a persona reading carefully — it fires from executing the prompt as given.
